impact: VAL-CAP-004 (1080p60 monitor capture 60s on NVENC, must-pass smoke row) cannot complete on KDE Plasma / NVIDIA. Test expects 1920x1080 source but portal picks 3840x2160 (KDE's preferred mode). Resolution lock via kscreen-doctor is overridden during test, causing capture cadence (89.3 fps vs nominal 60 fps) and drop-rate gates (96% vs required ≤0%) to fail. Smoke suite stops early at first must-pass red.
resolution: Resolved via two-stage kscreen-doctor display mode enforcement in VAL-CAP-004 driver (commit 70c8a9e). Enforcement locks display to 1080p60 pre-PipeWire-negotiation and confirms modeset before capture begins. KDE Plasma modeset reversion during capture is fully suppressed. VAL-CAP-004 PASS confirmed at §22 smoke row 4 on HEAD d335a09.
title: VAL-CAP-004 blocked: KDE Plasma restores 4K resolution mid-capture despite kscreen-doctor lock to 1080p60
